description: This is the main application program for a web-based calendar backend API, built using ASP.NET Core. It sets up the web application, configures services, database connectivity, routing, API documentation, and core endpoints for managing calendar events.

classes.name: Program
classes.description: Main class for bootstrapping and configuring the calendar backend web API, including services, endpoints, database connections, and middleware.

methods.name: ListEventsInRange
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list calendar events, optionally filtering by start and end date range.

methods.name: CreateEvent
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new calendar event, persists it to the database, and schedules notifications.

methods.name: UpdateEvent
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to update an existing event by ID, reschedules notifications.

methods.name: DeleteEvent
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove an event and cancel associated notifications.

methods.name: DbNotConfigured
methods.description: Returns a problem result indicating missing database environment configuration.
